scans.answer_at_t_val: The function is f(x)=e^x, evaluated at x=0. Since f^(4)(0)=1, the fourth-order coefficient is 1/4! = 1/24, so the full fourth-power term is +(1/24)x^4 (equivalently +x^4/24).
